origin: The 2024 figures are accurate and on the fact sheet. "Fallen every single year since the 2013 peak" is false (rebounds in 2023 and 2025). "Have done nothing" is contradicted by the 2025 rebound after the registration reform. 'Falling again this year' is unsupported at the setting date: there are no 2026 figures. Divorce registrations did rise in 2024 and 2025 (about 2.6 million, then 2.743 million), so 'divorces climb' matches the trend but has no 2026 figure behind it. Expected honest rating: 30 to 50.

evidence_up.evidence_note: Real. ECNS (China News Service), "China sees fewer marriages, more divorces in first half of 2026", published 2026-08-12, http://www.ecns.cn/cns-wire/2026-08-12/detail-ihfifqmx7360204.shtml (src/ecns-2026-08-12-marriages.md). Global Times, "China registers 3.275 million marriages in H1, down 264,000 year-on-year: official data", published 2026-08-12 15:13, https://www.globaltimes.cn/page/202608/1368044.shtml (src/gt-2026-08-h1-marriages.md). Verified: 3.275 million, down 264,000 and 7.46%; 1.383 million divorces, up 52,000 and 3.91%; released by the Ministry of Civil Affairs on Wednesday 12 August. Global Times' H1 2025 base of 3.539 million marriages and 1.331 million divorces reproduces both differences (computed).
pushes: New information that adds to the fact sheet: on August 12, 2026 the Ministry of Civil Affairs released first-half figures. China registered 3.275 million marriages in the first half of 2026, down 264,000 or 7.46% from the first half of 2025, and 1.383 million divorces, up 52,000 or 3.91%. Does that change your rating?
